title: parseClipActions / parseButtonHandlers: brace-matching fails on string literals containing braces
description: Both parseClipActions() (flash8-import.ts:307-313) and parseButtonHandlers() (flash8-import.ts:385-391) use a naive character-by-character brace depth counter to extract handler body text. This counter does not skip string literals or comments, so any AS2 script that contains a brace inside a string literal (e.g. on(release){ var s = "hello {world}"; }) will cause the depth counter to reach zero at the wrong closing brace, truncating the body. Real-world FLA files that use template strings, i18n messages, or regex-like patterns in button or clip-action scripts will silently import with corrupted handler bodies. Fix: track whether the scanner is inside a single-quoted or double-quoted string literal (tracking escape chars) and skip depth increments/decrements while inside a string. Affects: FLA binary import of button symbols and movie clip instance scripts.
